pages.title: Quantum Entangler
pages.text: The $(item)Quantum Entangler$(): spontaneous parametric down-conversion splits photons into entangled pairs, then binds them into qubits.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.

How it works for real: a pump photon enters a nonlinear crystal and splits into two lower-energy photons with correlated polarisations. Measure one and you know the other, however far away. No signal travels - Einstein's 'spooky action', but no message.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Entangled Photon Pair, Qubit, Superposition Crystal.
